messages:
incident-bot: Paging: Canary health alert for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. 5m error rate spike, automated rollback attempted and failed. @oncall please triage
jen: on it — switching to #incidents. what's the customer impact?
marco: seeing 7.8% 5xxs and tail latency up ~600ms from baseline. traffic is oscillating between model-v12 and model-v11 due to a feature-flag autoswitch loop.
leah: why is the flag oscillating? any recent infra changes?
parker: autoscaler had a bug that toggles the flag when SLOs breach; it triggered twice and left some routes pinned to the new variant. feature-flag service returning 409 on write due to lock.
jen: ok need a manual mitigation: either force-stable-variant or manual rollback of the routing config. which is faster?
marco: manual rollback via router is fastest. Suggest run:
```
# revert to pinned variant
redwoodctl route update --service gen-api --region eu-west-1 --target model-v11 --weight 100
```
deploy-bot: rollout 986742 started at 1789991248 (automated rollback). status: FAILED (lock conflict).
parker: i'm trying to flip the feature flag but raft lock is held by scaler-3. Trying kill to release.
product-ops: flag flip will affect a small % of enterprise customers. SC-42 and SC-99 reported latency but no error spikes on their end yet. informing CS.
cust-success: flagged customers notified of potential degradation, collecting logs from them.
leah: parker — do the route update. i'll coordinate drain and smoke tests. parker, paste the command output here when you run it.
parker: running route update now
```
$ redwoodctl route update --service gen-api --region eu-west-1 --target model-v11 --weight 100
Updating route... ok
Applied: route-gen-api-eu-west-1 -> model-v11 (100%)
```
parker: router shows 100% to model-v11 but some edge caches may still send to v12 for ~30s.
marco: starting connection drain: reducing connections on v12 pool.
jen: run smoke across 3 probe keys (smoke-eu-1..3) and post results.
leah: running smoke ->
```
$ smoke-test --endpoint eu-west-1 --probe smoke-eu-1
ok latency 120ms, no 5xx
$ smoke-test --probe smoke-eu-2
ok latency 130ms, no 5xx
$ smoke-test --probe smoke-eu-3
ok latency 140ms, no 5xx
```
leah: all three probes green. tail metrics still drifting but trending down.
product-ops: marking incident as "mitigated" for traffic; we'll keep monitoring 30m.
parker: note: flag service still has a stale lock entry from scaler-3, opened a ticket to clean up. preventing future oscillation requires autoscaler patch.
marco: raising a follow-up: add a short cooldown to autoswitch and fix lock handling. I'll create PR and tag @eng-runtime.
cust-success: thanks team — customers acknowledged the update, will reopen if they see anything else.
jen: oncall handoff to leah for postmortem and communications. leah, you're owner for next steps. :handshake:
leah: accepted. will run postmortem template, add timeline, and include playbook updates (force-stable route + drain checklist). closing thread once postmortem link posted.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Alert suppressed for 30m."
